Collect and equip

This native-time capture includes a normal enemy defeat, item collection, and equipment change through the inventory.

Collect salvage and equipment, then equip the Sluice edge
Test method: browser capture, sample-level analysis, and scripted gameplay. No direct human listening test was available in this session. MP3 previews are supplied for listening; the measurements use uncompressed WAV data. The game synthesizes its sound locally and does not need these samples.
